title: Continuous-fire discipline
summary: Some target switching tasks reward smooth continuous acquisition and micro-correction while holding fire instead of discrete stab-click behavior on every target.
cues: Flow through the switch instead of hard resetting every target
Let micro-corrections happen under control while the shot stays active
Judge the full transition, not just the first snap
failureModes: Turning hold-fire switching into repeated stop-start clicks
Overvaluing raw snap speed while the tracked finish is unstable
